notes: Gold OpenDrop V4 main board generates HV (MAX1771ESA on V_HV) and mates cartridge HV rail V_HV_C / return GND_C through Mini-DIMM.
TLP222A optocouplers (4×) isolate HV switching from LV logic — architecture must keep isolate_high_voltage work on hv_controller_main.
V_USB is a separate LV host rail — electrode/FLUXL nets must never be classified as USB/LV-only.
Cartridge carries V_HV_C + GND_C + FLUXL_* electrode array; pin-map class contract is power/return vs electrode array.
